reference_sql:
SELECT parent_category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders,
       SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) / SUM(net_revenue_eur), 1) AS web_revenue_pct
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY parent_category
HAVING AVG(net_revenue_eur) > 150
ORDER BY revenue_eur DESC
